# BC Observatory: code changes

> Merged pull requests of Microsoft's Business Central code (microsoft/BCApps) that touch AL source: what changed, in our words,
> joined by exact file path to the AL object pages. Tier official, metadata only. Frontmatter: schemas/frontmatter.change.json.

1074 changes, newest first.

- [#12463 Fix Email upgrade writing during no-transaction upgrade test](bcapps/12463.md): Email Installer no longer re-registers email tables based on allowed-table row presence, only checking upgrade tags or forced refresh to prevent unwanted database writes during upgrade tests. (main, 2026-10-07, fix)
- [#11560 [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Enabling EDI capabilities with E-Documents. Send path (Self-Billed Purchase Invoice/Credit Memo → E-Document)](bcapps/11560.md): Enables exporting self-billed purchase invoices and credit memos as Peppol BIS 3.0 e-documents, with automatic type assignment based on vendor self-billing agreements and new manual creation actions on posted purchase pages. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#12207 [MCP] Prepare Data Query Tools for billing](bcapps/12207.md): Data Query Tools for MCP are now marked billable with a pricing acknowledgement requirement before activation. When imported, users are prompted to confirm pricing; headless imports default to disabled. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#11959 [Master]-Production Order Fails to Finish Due to Quantity Rounding Difference Between Component Consumption and Item Tracking Quantity - Copy](bcapps/11959.md): Production orders now correctly handle quantity rounding differences between component consumption and item tracking quantities to prevent finish failures. (main, 2026-10-07, fix)
- [#12064 Support SharePoint paths containing hash and percent characters](bcapps/12064.md): SharePoint connector now supports file paths containing hash and percent characters by adding separate decoded-path APIs backed by ResourcePath endpoints, with a new REST Base Folder Path Format setting to control URL decoding behavior. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#12135 Fix Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration](bcapps/12135.md): Corrected field mappings and filtering logic in the Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration to properly transfer legacy values into new GB fields using type-correct filters. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12215 [Shopify] Link grouped invoice to all originating orders](bcapps/12215.md): Invoice document linking to Shopify orders now correctly associates a single invoice with all originating Shopify orders when multiple shipments are grouped, instead of retaining filters from earlier shipments. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12214 [Shopify] Store currency handling for auto-created orders](bcapps/12214.md): The Shopify connector now persists the currency handling mode used during order processing to the Shopify order record, ensuring the stored value reflects the actual mode applied to the created sales document even if the shop configuration changes during synchronization. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#10772 [Bug Fix] #304: [SOA] Re-resolve new sender to created contact after 'I have added the contact'](bcapps/10772.md): Sales Order Agent now correctly re-resolves sender information to the newly created contact after a user adds a contact in the chat, allowing the agent to proceed instead of reporting the customer cannot be found. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12325 [Expense tests] Re-enable reviewed APIs and consolidate Expense fixes](bcapps/12325.md): Expense API tests are re-enabled by consolidating authentication mechanisms and removing API-specific test exclusions, while fixing policy snapshot test issues and preserving non-API exclusions. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12118 Fix Email Inbox retention policy failing on missing indirect Read permission](bcapps/12118.md): Email Inbox retention policy no longer fails due to missing indirect read permission and now registers the table for existing tenants through an upgrade tag. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12261 Stop repeated rescheduling of Dataverse synch jobs on bulk changes](bcapps/12261.md): The Dataverse synchronization job reschedule logic now checks both the scheduled task's next run time and the job queue entry's earliest start date to avoid repeated rescheduling during bulk changes, reducing unnecessary Service Bus costs. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12309 Fix infinite recursion in Config. Package Field XML name generation](bcapps/12309.md): Fixed infinite recursion in XML element name generation when configuration package fields produce duplicate XML names by replacing recursion with a bounded loop that appends counters and properly shortens base names. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12188 [Master]-Reserved quantities do not match the expected quantities after planning - regression due to correction](bcapps/12188.md): Reserved quantities now correctly match expected quantities in manufacturing inventory profile offsetting by fixing a regression in the calculation logic. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#9347 Fix IssueDate in E-Documents for Germany](bcapps/9347.md): Fixed the IssueDate field in German E-Document exports (XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats) to ensure correct date handling. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#2395 Prevent workflow telemetry failures from failing the workflow](al-go/2395.md): WorkflowPostProcess telemetry failures no longer cause the entire workflow to fail, allowing GitHub API errors during finalization to remain visible in logs without blocking successful builds. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12370 Guard removed Manufacturing Setup fields with CLEANSCHEMA30 preprocessor](bcapps/12370.md): Manufacturing Setup fields marked as removed in version 30.0 are wrapped with preprocessor guards to comply with ObsoleteTag rules and match existing conventions in the file. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12139 [Shopify] Disable Create Sales Documents for empty order views](bcapps/12139.md): The Create Sales Documents action on the Shopify Orders page is now disabled when the current filtered view contains no orders, preventing users from attempting to create documents with no data. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12320 Fix 409 conflict in APIV2 Company Info E2E description test](bcapps/12320.md): Fixed 409 conflict errors in APIV2 Company Info E2E tests by disabling test isolation to allow commits to take effect, and changed Environment Information reads to no longer write the singleton record. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#214 UI knowledge: notification recall needs a known Id; open mixed-type documents through Page Management](bcquality/214.md): Two new UI design guidance articles added to help developers properly manage notifications by using known IDs for recall and handle multi-document routing through Page Management instead of hard-coded mappings. (main, 2026-10-06, feature)
- [#208 2 AL/BC patterns: TableRelation field length and RecordRef.Open Temp parameter](bcquality/208.md): Two new knowledge articles identify silent runtime mismatches in table relations and record reference calls that compile without diagnostic warnings. The articles explain the exact rules for field length matching and the pitfalls of using RecordRef.Open with the temporary parameter flag. (main, 2026-10-06, feature)
- [#12304 [Master]-Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'](bcapps/12304.md): Fixed a page opening issue caused by the FlowField 'Last Run By User' in Financial Report tables by restructuring how the user tracking data is stored and calculated. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12260 [Shopify] Fix shop card transaction navigation](bcapps/12260.md): The Shopify Shop Card payment transaction navigation now opens the correct transaction list and filters by the Shop field instead of the obsolete Shop Code FlowField. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#11848 [main] Report 11564, Foreign Currency Layout: foreign currency opening balance is not included](bcapps/11848.md): Report 11564 now correctly includes foreign currency opening balances for G/L accounts with multiple registered source currencies, fixing previously understated running FCY balances. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12290 Remove CLEAN27 from Service Management](bcapps/12290.md): Service Management objects are cleaned up by removing CLEAN27 code artifacts across multiple localization layers, including deprecated pages and codeunits. (main, 2026-10-06, refactor)
- [#12143 Bug 649440: [Subcontracting] [IT] Disable Legacy Subcontracting leaves Component Supply Method empty after conversion](bcapps/12143.md): The Italian subcontracting legacy migration now correctly maps the vendor's procurement setting to the component supply method for both production BOM lines and existing production-order components during conversion. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12145 [Main]-Item charge assignment update Error on sales order when there is no Price. "Sorry, we just updated this page. Reopen it and try again." when running in SaaS](bcapps/12145.md): Fixed an error on sales orders when assigning item charges by amount when some item lines have no price. The assignment record set is now refreshed after bulk updates to prevent stale data issues. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12307 Make UpgradeDefaultDimensions ParentId backfill set-based (via DataTransfer)](bcapps/12307.md): The UpgradeDefaultDimensions procedure now uses set-based DataTransfer operations instead of row-by-row processing to backfill ParentId fields in Default Dimension records, significantly reducing upgrade runtime on large tables. (main, 2026-10-05, performance)
- [#12055 [E-Documents Core] Show error for unmatched inbound Order Response](bcapps/12055.md): Unmatched inbound PEPPOL Order Responses now produce a descriptive error and remain visible in the E-Document list instead of being silently deleted. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11604 fix: capture Shopify fulfillment deliveredAt timestamp](bcapps/11604.md): The Shopify connector now captures and displays the fulfillment delivery timestamp from Shopify, enabling users to see when shipments were actually delivered. A new field stores the deliveredAt value, the GraphQL query requests it, and the import logic parses it across both order fetches and shipment exports. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12059 [Master]-Reverse Production Entry fails when production output is posted using a non-base Unit of Measure.](bcapps/12059.md): The undo production entry function now correctly handles non-base units of measure when reversing production output postings. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12062 [Master]-[Quality Management] Workflow events are not localized](bcapps/12062.md): Workflow event labels in the Quality Management app are now properly localized for international users. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11637 [Master]- Create Documents on Recurring Billing ignores the Partner filter and fails when a vendor billing proposal exists](bcapps/11637.md): Fixed an issue in recurring billing where the Partner filter was ignored when creating documents, which also prevented document creation when a vendor billing proposal existed. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11994 [Master]- [Planning Worksheet] Production Copy to Req. Wksh fails because destination fields are missing](bcapps/11994.md): Fixed a bug where the Carry Out Action Message - Planning report failed to copy production orders to requisition worksheets due to missing destination fields being populated. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12256 [Payables Agent] Exclude agent accounts from eligible users](bcapps/12256.md): Payables Agent Setup now excludes users with Agent license type from the eligible invoice creator list to prevent access-control errors when agent accounts create posted invoices. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12141 [Master]-Incorrect project ledger costs when non-deductible VAT is posted to a foreign-currency project](bcapps/12141.md): Fixed incorrect project ledger costs when posting non-deductible VAT to a foreign-currency project by correcting currency conversions in the non-deductible VAT implementation. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#9953 Rename AppSource UI text to Marketplace](bcapps/9953.md): User-facing text that references AppSource has been updated to use Marketplace terminology throughout the application and system components. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12255 Fix overwrite import of exported system permission sets](bcapps/12255.md): System permission set imports with overwrite option now correctly delete permissions and relations that differ from the imported file, instead of merging silently. The fix handles both system and tenant format files, with tenant format now using exact role ID matching. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#10182 [Bug]: [Subscription Billing] Payment discount on contract invoices comes from the customer, not from the contract's payment terms](bcapps/10182.md): Payment discount percentages on subscription billing invoices now correctly use the contract's payment terms instead of the customer or vendor's payment terms. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#177 Add retention policy knowledge to the privacy domain](bcquality/177.md): Added guidance to the privacy domain in BCQuality about registering extension-owned tables for retention policies and shipping default retention policy setups, addressing common mistakes in how extensions handle log table cleanup. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12097 [29.X]-[Quality Management] Workflow events are not localized](bcapps/12097.md): Workflow event labels in the Quality Management module are now properly localized instead of showing hardcoded English text. (releases/29.x, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#218 Harden findings-report producer constraints](bcquality/218.md): Findings reports now enforce stricter validation rules for finding IDs, confidence levels, and severity values to prevent contract failures. Finding IDs must not contain citation fragments, uncited findings are restricted to medium/low confidence and minor/info severity, and a checklist clarifies proper handling of citation paths and line numbering. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#213 knowledge(events): database trigger setup flags may only be set to true](bcquality/213.md): A new quality rule checks that database trigger setup flags in the Global Triggers event can only be set to true, preventing subscribers from inadvertently clearing flags set by other integrations or system features. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#215 knowledge(performance): grouped query (Count + ColumnFilter = HAVING) for distinct values and duplicates](bcquality/215.md): A new performance knowledge article teaches developers how to use query objects with grouped methods and column filters to detect duplicate values in a single SQL statement instead of looping with multiple queries. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#209 3 AL/BC patterns: Insert/Delete trigger defaults on master data and declined Confirm in OnValidate](bcquality/209.md): Three new articles guide developers to use triggers when writing or deleting master data and to properly abort validations when user confirmation is declined. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#216 knowledge(style): a new procedure that changes the page's current record should take it as var Record](bcquality/216.md): New style guidance document for AL developers on when procedures that modify a record should take the record as a var parameter, with good and bad code samples and exclusions. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12124 Fix default bin assignment when creating purchase orders for drop shipments](bcapps/12124.md): Fixed default bin assignment for drop shipments when creating purchase orders from sales orders. The requisition line no longer incorrectly receives a default bin during item validation when the drop-shipment flag is set. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)

Order and Recording headers](bcapps/9180.md): Record links attached to physical inventory order and recording headers are now copied to their posted documents, matching the behavior of sales, purchase, and warehouse posting flows. - [#12194 Harden web request helpers: opt-in default credentials](bcapps/12194.md): Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. now disable default credentials by default and require callers to opt in with SetUseDefaultCredentials(true) for on-premises installations, preventing unintended transmission of Business Central service account credentials to external hosts. (main, 2026-10-02, refactor)
- [#210 knowledge(upgrade): upgrade code must not use ChangeCompany](bcquality/210.md): New quality rule and knowledge article prevent upgrade code from using ChangeCompany, which can cause data races, duplicate upgrades, and trigger misexecution in the calling company context. - [#12070 Fix inconsistent CLEAN27/CLEAN28 tags in E-Document apps](bcapps/12070.md): E-Document apps now use consistent CLEAN27 and CLEAN28 tags so each cleanup step can be removed independently, fixing compilation failures when only CLEAN27 was applied. (main, 2026-09-30, fix)
- [#2367 Enhance NuGet feed selection to support pre-release packages](al-go/2367.md): AL-Go now supports pre-release NuGet packages by adding an `-allowPrerelease` suffix to the nuGetFeedSelectMode setting, enabling developers to include pre-release versions in dependency resolution. - [#2382 Fix dependency artifact pattern for branch names with glob-special characters](al-go/2382.md): Fixed a bug where dependency artifact downloads failed silently when branch names contained special characters that minimatch interprets, such as commas, braces, or parentheses. - [#11822 Added missing indexes for GP historical snapshot](bcapps/11822.md): Added missing indexes to three GP historical snapshot staging tables to improve query performance during data migration. (main, 2026-09-30, performance)
- [#11741 [MCP] Add company and environment descriptions](bcapps/11741.md): Company and environment descriptions are now stored and exposed via APIs to provide richer context for MCP and other consumers. Company descriptions are stored as BLOBs in Company Information, environment descriptions once per database in System Application, and both are made available as read-only fields in API v2.0. (main, 2026-09-30, feature)
- [#11968 Bug 648782: omit the buyer PartyTaxScheme when the company has no VAT registration](bcapps/11968.md): Purchase order PEPPOL export now omits the PartyTaxScheme block when the company has no VAT registration number, preventing invalid XML validation failures. (main, 2026-09-30, fix)
- [#2379 Avoid CI/CD runs for template SHA-only system updates](al-go/2379.md): The system no longer commits template SHA changes when only an empty commit occurs in the template repository, preventing unnecessary CI/CD triggers with no actual file modifications. (main, 2026-09-30, fix)
